factsSinceLastLlm.text: Implement assignCluster() function: assignCluster() function is fully implemented with all acceptance criteria met: (1) Fetches existing clusters for greenhouse with isolation enforcement, (2) Calls Haiku with cluster assignment prompt including signal extraction and existing clusters, (3) Parses JSON response with Zod schema validation, (4) Returns ClusterAssignment with cluster_id and isNew flag, (5) Validates cluster belongs to greenhouse on assignment. All error cases wrapped in SignalProcessingError for dead-letter routing.
